title: Zach Bryan Gets Candid About Sobriety in Matthew McConaughey Interview: ‘Why Am I Drinking?’
summary: The country star’s two-hour conversation with the Oscar-winning actor was uploaded to YouTube on Oct. 16.
body: Zach Bryan is opening up about his sobriety journey in a new interview with Matthew McConaughey . The 30-year-old country star sat down with the Oscar-winning actor for a two-hour conversation , reflecting on his relationship with alcohol and the experience that ultimately led him to quit drinking. title: ‘I’m Experiencing Everything I’ve Ever Wanted’: Recapping Miley’s Live Return, On Her Own Terms
summary: Here's what went down during Miley's first of two sold-out nights at the iconic Hollywood Bowl.
body: “It’s always been a dream of mine to play such an iconic venue,” Miley wrote on social media just hours ahead of her Hollywood Bowl performance on Friday night (Oct. 16). It was a funny reminder for longtime fans who have seen the child actor ascend to pop star heights; while Miley has been around and iconic for so many years, it’s really been the last few in which her career has been celebrated more widely. At the 2024 Grammys, she won her first award (actually, two) for her Billboard Hot 100 No. 1 smash “Flowers,” taking home record of the year and best pop solo performance. In 2025, she joined Spotify’s exclusive Billions Club, delivering a hits-filled set in Paris to perform her biggest songs including “Wrecking Ball” and “The Climb.” And earlier this year, she celebrated the 20th anniversary of Hannah Montana with a Disney+ special and rare media blitz. Already this year, she dropped Cyrus from her stage name — joining mononymous legends like Madonna, Cher and Beyoncé. title: Diddy Moved From New Jersey Prison to Similar Facility in Pennsylvania
summary: The transfer follows reports that the music mogul has gotten into prison fights and was living a “pampered” life behind bars.
body: Sean “Diddy” Combs has been transferred from a low-security prison in New Jersey to a similar federal facility in Pennsylvania, Billboard can confirm. A spokesperson for the Federal Bureau of Prisons told Billboard that Combs was moved on Friday (Oct. 16) from FCI Fort Dix to FCI Allenwood’s low-security section. “For privacy, safety and security reasons, we do not discuss the conditions of confinement for any individual in our custody, including reasons for transfer,” said the prison rep. The Fort Dix prison in New Jersey and Allenwood facility in Pennsylvania are the same level of low-security institution. Combs’ spokesperson, Juda Engelmayer , said in a statement to Billboard , “We appreciate the Bureau of Prisons taking the safety and security of Sean and everyone involved seriously.” “His transfer from one low-security facility to another is an important distinction, and while we cannot speak to the BOP’s specific reasons for the move, it is consistent with a decision made with safety and security in mind,” added Engelmayer. “We are grateful for the attention being given to his well-being and hope he can continue serving his tim…

title: Swizz Beatz Reveals Michael Jackson Had a Crush on Alicia Keys: ‘I Think Janet Was the One That Told A.K.’
summary: The Bronx beatmaker thought it was cool, so he set up Alicia & Michael meeting at the King of Pop's house.
body: Swizz Beatz and Alicia Keys stopped by Michael Jackson ‘s house shortly before the King of Pop’s untimely death back in 2009. The Bronx record producer recently stopped by The Real Report With Tony Yayo and Uncle Murda and revealed that Jackson apparently had a crush on his R&B superstar wife. Swizz didn’t feel offended or disrespected or anything like that. He actually thought it was kind’ve “cool” and took initiative to set a meet-up between the two singers. “I found out that Michael had a crush on my wife. In a cool way, but Michael’s a virgo, so I don’t know. I’m a virgo,” he said jokingly. “And so I think Janet was the one that told A.K. and she was like, ‘You know, my brother always had a crush on you.’ So I thought it was cool to set up for her to meet him. Just for both of them to just have that moment as fans of each other.” He added: “We set up the meeting at the crib. We go to the house, Michael was so cool Michael was so cool, bro.
